# Temple Scroll Column 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 2 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged; partial lines survive

---

**2:1** [...] and I shall consecrate [my] tem[ple ...]

**2:2** [...] in which I will cause my glory to dwell [...]

**2:3** [...] upon it the cloud [...] and I shall appear to them [...]

**2:4** [...] until the day of creation, [when] I shall create my temple [...]

**2:5** [...] and I shall establish it for myself for all the days [...]

**2:6** [...] according to the covenant which I made with Jacob [...]

**2:7** [...] at Bethel [...]

**2:8** [...] covenant [...] I shall establish [...]

**2:9** [...] for them [...] an everlasting covenant [...]

**2:10** [...] and I shall be their God [...]

**2:11** [...] and they shall be my people [...]

**2:12** [...] in the midst of my sanctuary forever [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 2 preserves God speaking in the first person about the consecration of the temple and the eternal covenant. The "day of creation" is a notable phrase referring to the eschatological moment when God will personally create the definitive temple. The covenant formula in lines 10-11 echoes Jeremiah 31:33 and Ezekiel 37:27.*
